description: Update a business's profile: name, description, about text, opening hours, contact info, currency, default locale, the locales visitors can switch between, menu display options, country, business details, or place (location, address, timezone, category, cuisines). Only provided fields change.

contact_info.description: Contact info: phone, email, address, instagram

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the business operates in. ADVISORY: it seeds suggested menu options (apply_country_settings) and drives check_compliance. It never changes what the site renders.

hours.description: Opening hours keyed mon..sun, each {"open":"10:30","close":"22:00"} or {"closed":true}

legal_info.description: Business details published on the site when filled in: tradeName, taxNumber, registrationNumber, registeredAddress, contactEmail, contactPhone, plus `extra` label/value pairs for anything a jurisdiction names differently (a Vergi Dairesi, a US EIN). All optional.

maps_url.description: A Google Maps, Apple Maps, Yandex or OpenStreetMap link (short share links work), or a "lat, lng" pair. Sets the coordinates.

menu_options.description: How the published menu presents itself: `menuNotice` (free text shown above the menu, in the owner's own words), `showPriceEffectiveDate`, and `orderingExcludedTags` (tags that can be listed but not ordered online, e.g. alcohol). This is the ONLY thing that changes what the site renders.

place.description: Where the business is and what kind of place it is: lat/lng; address {streetAddress, addressLocality (district), addressRegion (city or province), postalCode, addressCountry (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)}; timezone (IANA, e.g. "Europe/Istanbul"); category (e.g. restaurant, cafe, bakery, bar, meyhane, fast_food, dessert_shop); up to 6 cuisines (e.g. turkish, kebab, seafood, sushi, vegan). Merged into what is stored: keys you pass replace, keys you leave out stay.

supported_locales.description: Locales visitors can switch between, e.g. ["pl","en"]; the default locale is always included

name: update_business
title: Update business
